title: The Reconnaissance Playbook
tagline: Individual techniques are skills. A methodology is what makes you a professional.
description: The capstone mission of Reconnaissance & Footprinting. Learn how professional penetration testers combine WHOIS, DNS enumeration, Google Dorking, and OSINT into a single structured workflow — from client brief to attack surface map. Master the complete passive reconnaissance methodology used in real engagements, including scope planning, intelligence organisation, attack surface prioritisation, and professional reporting.
author: Cyber Learn Team
learningObjectives: Describe the complete professional passive reconnaissance workflow from scope review to recon report
Explain how to plan a reconnaissance phase before beginning any information gathering
Combine WHOIS, DNS enumeration, and search engine reconnaissance into a single coherent intelligence profile
Prioritise an attack surface by severity and exploitability based on passive recon findings
Identify when passive reconnaissance is complete and active testing can begin
Explain the professional and ethical standards governing scope, escalation, and documentation
skills: Planning a passive reconnaissance phase from a client scope document
Building a structured intelligence profile by correlating WHOIS, DNS, and OSINT findings
Prioritising an attack surface into Critical / High / Medium / Low tiers
Writing a reconnaissance section of a professional penetration test report
Making professional judgement calls on scope boundaries and immediate escalation
